notes.text: Centred colophon line (Zapisano ot chukchi Ajchaivata osenyu 1897 g. v Nizhnekolymske) is a one-line MainZone-P; could equally be MainZone-Other. No ruling decides it, so left to the editor.
Line 1 is in band 1 with the head line (line 0) but is not visible in the composite; no printed row of its own is apparent.
